purpose: Record a targeted public-source recheck after the frozen station-to-vehicle search without presenting metadata or plotted summaries as raw validation.
eligibility_rule: A new independent holdout must expose rights-cleared station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels on one common clock, with units, initial conditions, protocol metadata and reusable data rights.

sources.name: European Hydrogen Observatory hydrogen refuelling stations datastream
sources.observed_scope: Public station inventory and infrastructure/dispenser categories.
sources.reason: No synchronized engineering transient for a station-to-vehicle fill was exposed.

sources.name: H2-Stations export API v2 documentation
sources.observed_scope: Static layout and operational availability, usage, storage and pricing signal documentation.
sources.reason: The documented API does not provide a rights-cleared common-clock pressure, temperature and transfer-flow trace linking station and vehicle.

sources.name: California Air Resources Board in-use light-duty HRS study
sources.observed_scope: Report figures and aggregate in-use fueling performance, including pressure, temperature and mass-flow plots.
sources.reason: No reusable row-level synchronized logger archive, complete channel dictionary and data-reuse terms were found at the public endpoint.

sources.name: DOE/NREL heavy-duty fueling performance report
sources.observed_scope: Protocol and event-level performance summaries for heavy-duty fueling.
sources.reason: The public report does not expose the common-clock raw station/controller/dispenser/vehicle channels required by the frozen holdout.

sources.name: NREL H2FillS software and user manual
sources.observed_scope: A registered simulation tool that reports station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow time series and describes validation against empirical fueling profiles.
sources.reason: The public page and manual describe model outputs and input formats but do not release a rights-cleared, outcome-unseen common-clock measured station/controller/dispenser/vehicle archive.

claim_boundary: This follow-up is a public-access availability audit. It does not prove that restricted or unpublished traces do not exist and does not support station-to-vehicle accuracy, vehicle-controller validation or field-safety claims.
